# Cleanroom consumables

Cleanroom is one of the specialty verticals in our growth plan (Thomas Scientific growth plan). The material available here does not describe our current cleanroom range, so we cannot confirm specific products, stock depth or certifications on this page.

## What we can confirm

- Cleanroom is named alongside cannabis-testing, cold-chain and forensics as a specialty vertical (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
- The plan treats specialty verticals as a margin lever, together with private label, punchout ordering and vendor-managed inventory (VMI) (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
- The year-three target includes an 11th distribution center through a West Coast cleanroom or life-science tuck-in (est., Thomas Scientific growth plan).

## Where cleanroom sits

| Plan stage | Network | Cleanroom link |
|---|---|---|
| Today | 9 distribution centers | Range not detailed in the plan |
| Year one | 9 distribution centers | No acquisitions while the refinancing is open |
| Year two | 10 (Midwest/Texas tuck-in, est.) | No cleanroom tie stated |
| Year three | 11 (est.) | West Coast cleanroom or life-science tuck-in, about $15M revenue (est.) |

The plan calls these figures assumptions, not forecasts (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

## What would answer this fully

- A catalog extract of current cleanroom items by category: gloves, garments, wipes, swabs and mats.
- Sales by category for the last 12 months, to show whether cleanroom is a real line today or mainly a target.
- Supplier and private-label coverage for cleanroom items.
- How many of the 713 Pursue and 2,317 Nurture sites run controlled environments. The demand map scores 27,503 lab, pathology and hospital sites, but the context does not show a cleanroom flag (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

## Timing

- Our first-lien loan matures December 14, 2027 (Thomas Scientific public filings).
- Every growth lever is sequenced behind cash and refinancing. Any cleanroom acquisition is a year-three option, not a near-term move (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
- Building out cleanroom through our own range, private label and VMI does not depend on an acquisition.

A credible cleanroom line is one of the clearest ways to show lenders and future buyers that Thomas earns specialist margins, not commodity-distributor margins, ahead of the December 2027 refinancing.

## Next actions

1. Pull a cleanroom SKU and 12-month sales extract to establish today's baseline.
2. Add a controlled-environment flag to the scored-site demand map and count matching Pursue and Nurture sites.
3. Identify cleanroom items that could move to private label or VMI without capital spend before the refinancing.
4. Keep a short list of West Coast cleanroom tuck-in candidates for review once the refinancing closes.
